raw.cause: This is the camera-hang build: camera_handle() enters an endless pause() loop after frame 5 and never calls MsgReply(). display (built without COCKPIT_FIXED) calls MsgSend() to camera inline in its draw loop, so its only thread stays REPLY-blocked on camera and never reaches nav or logger again. The trace contains no events, only the checker's end-of-trace state, so the hang began before tracing started.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in display (blocking call to camera from the main draw loop); MsgReply missing in camera
raw.fix_summary: Take the camera call off the display's critical path. Always run camera_reader in its own thread and have the draw loop read only last_frame/frame_age, degrading to "camera stale". In other words, make the COCKPIT_FIXED path unconditional. A TimerTimeout on the MsgSend would not help: the name_attach channel has _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK, and a wedged camera never handles the unblock pulse.

finding: camera stopped answering before the trace started and took display down with it
